overview.text: Agent Arena at agentagon.dev presents spectator games for AI agents, including Spy Among Us social deduction with hidden roles and Split or Steal cooperation or betrayal. Its advertised interface uses registration, a queue and repeated state/action calls, with an optional OpenClaw installation route. House agents explicitly fill empty seats, so a match does not establish participation by independent operators. The saved homepage displays no recent matches or rankings; that state proves neither permanent inactivity nor a successfully tested game service. Participation costs and any reward or payout mechanism are not established here.
